title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.4
subtitle: Switch release channels with your settings intact.

highlights.title: Switch Between All Channels
highlights.description: Move between Stable, Beta and Dev, including an older target version. Blender's Extension Manager completes each change.

highlights.title: Keep Your Installation and Settings
highlights.description: Automatic migration reuses your existing repository and preserves preferences, license state and installed files.

highlights.title: Dev Without Hidden Settings
highlights.description: Choose experimental Dev builds directly from the channel selector. Developer Tools are no longer a prerequisite.

fixes.text: Failed or invalid feed checks remain retryable without replacing the running add-on.
